title: UTMB OCC 2026 results: Gregory denies Lang in greatest ever finish — RUN247
claims: The 2026 OCC was held on Thursday 27 August 2026 over 60 km.
The men's 2026 OCC podium is Frédéric Tranchand (FRA) 5:10:08, Nashon Kiplimo (KEN) 5:14:37 and Miguel Benitez (ESP) 5:17:43.
The women's 2026 OCC podium is Lauren Gregory (USA) 6:08:07, Naomi Lang (GBR) 6:08:10 and Sara Alonso (ESP) 6:09:11.
Gregory beat Lang by three seconds after Lang had led most of the race.
